description.es: Digna y Marta van a visitar a Fina. Marta dice que va a contar que ella era la otra mujer. Digna y Fina no se lo permiten. Andrés encuentra a un abogado que accede a defender a Fina.
description.en: Digna and Marta go to visit Fina. Marta says that she will tell them that she was the other woman. Digna and Fina do not allow it. Andrés finds a lawyer who agrees to defend Fina.
